run_doc2query_batch: run doc2query to generate synthetic queries from documents using an LLM model with batch API support
run_format_example: run format_example to parse LLM output and create query-positive-negative triplets using BM25 hard negatives
run_base_data_to_dict: run base_data_to_dict to convert a list of base data items into a dictionary keyed by doc_id
run_gather_batch_results: run gather_results to wait for batch API job completion and process outputs into training data
run_bm25_miner_cli: run the CLI to generate synthetic question-answer pairs from documents with configurable model, dataset, and filter options
